_readme: CHECK constraints on the session-record tables, as pg_get_constraintdef prints them. Diffed by scripts/check-session-record-checks.mjs in check-schema.yml. Regenerate with --write only for a deliberate change.

checks.ratings.ratings_session_rater_known: CHECK (((session_id IS NULL) OR (user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (tombstone_key IS NOT NULL)))
checks.wines.wines_added_by_identity_id_chk: CHECK (((added_by_identity_id IS NULL) OR ((added_by_identity_id)::text ~ '^u:[0-9]+$'::text) OR ((added_by_identity_id)::text ~* '^a:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text) OR ((added_by_identity_id)::text ~* '^d:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text)))
checks.wines.wines_catalog_link_check: CHECK (((vintage_id IS NULL) OR (product_id IS NOT NULL)))
